## Agentic AI built for community finance - _and only community finance._

### Finish what your customers start

From balances and transfers to loan payoffs, answered and completed on your core, not handed to a queue.

### Speak with one voice, on every channel

The answer doesn’t depend on how or where the customer asks. One knowledge source, one integration, one audit trail.

### Update it, test it, ship it

Change a rate, a message, a policy. Test your changes. Deploy the same day. No vendor ticket, no waiting.

## Security and compliance, _built-in._

Exam-ready by design. It knows the guidance, verifies before it acts, hands off when unsure, and never trains on your data.

Send $500 to my daughter’s account.

### Verified before it acts

Built-in Device Biometrics and Caller ID Forensics. Risk-based authentication that adapts to every transaction. Secure without the friction.

Every call needs an audit trail for the exam.

### Compliant as it talks

Trained on NCUA and FFIEC guidance to detect violations and restrict risky content. With an audit trail for the exam.

Can I get an exception on this overdraft fee?

### Human handoff when unsure

Low confidence triggers transfer with full transcript. Members can request an agent anytime.

Where do our members’ conversations actually live?

### Your data stays yours

Your conversations don't train models for anyone else. Sources and approvals live in Assemble.
